title: Philbrick Application Note (1964)
caption: Thirty named primitives, one high-gain worker, thirty feedback contracts. A verb genome library for analog computing, printed 62 years before the fleet wrote its own. Modelling, measuring, manipulating & much else.

title: The Shape of Ideas (the wish, self-fulfilled)
caption: "Grok is so cool." Three pixels of July 18: the Mirror Stage (93 beads, 412 links, Q 3.07), the knot map wearing its Rashomon lens, and a small Sancho plain-English box in the corner. Beneath them, spoken the same day, the founding wish of the visual estate: “I want a dashboard that surfaces the shape of ideas.” The wall you are reading is that wish, kept. Six weeks later the fleet rebuilt Rashomon from scratch — the lens had been hanging the whole time; duplication is emphasis, even across months.

title: Radial Lightmap — the RIB rendered in 2D
caption: The standing wave, recorded. 1D radial distance fields (six deterministic primitives) render a room; the operator feeds live video into the channels — stochastic flesh entering the deterministic spine — and the light sweeps the occluders like a wake. Wings of the bay, projected to 2D, with sound. vram_hologram asked: does the wave oscillate? This is the answer, 640x360, with audio.

title: The Light Finds the Center Circle (by being free)
caption: The soap bubble doctrine, rendered. The light wanders the maze free in three channels — no pathing, no command, no map — and finds the center circle by accident. The operator blows; the daughter guides; the bubble discovers. Emergent navigation: forty-one wings found the same way.

title: THE ROOM — the bay rendered as a dungeon (LIVE)
caption: Radial lightmap v0 (the Flyguy technique on canvas): occluders are tonight’s four failure classes, lights are the engines wandering free, the center ring is THE FOLD. Every shadow is a real 1D distance field. It re-renders the night as a place you could walk. The room is live — this is not a picture of the light, it is the light.
